annotation.title_en: National AI Action Plan for Thailand Development, 6-Year Period (2022–2027)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation; Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (Thailand)
annotation.summary_en: Thailand's national six-year AI action plan (2022–2027) by the higher education and digital ministries. Five strategies cover AI ethics, law and regulation readiness, infrastructure, talent, R&D, and adoption, with a National AI Committee. Robotics, autonomous vehicles and elder-care robots appear only in passing; the focus is innovation and economic growth.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy 1 prepares social, ethical, legal and regulatory readiness for AI and aims to issue one AI law/regulation
Strategy 2 builds AI infrastructure, data platform and HPC services
Strategies 3–5 cover AI talent, R&D and sandbox-supported adoption in government and target industries
National AI Committee and secretariat established to drive implementation
Targets include rising to top 50 in Government AI Readiness Index and 30,000 AI personnel
